snippet.title: Streets of Rage 2 - Trailer
snippet.description: Originally released on the Mega Drive in 1992, Streets of Rage 2 refined the blueprint set in Streets Of Rage delivering an accomplished and compelling game experience. The team work together to defeat Mr. X and rescue Adam from the Syndicate .... Adam's fate is in your hands.
